subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Which official organization-owned GitHub OAuth app should become the production ClawHub client, and who will perform the protected credential rotation and validation?
rationale: The displayed consent identity is selected by a third-party OAuth app and production secrets, neither of which can be safely changed or proven by a repository patch.

options.title: Rotate to an official app
options.body: Create or transfer an organization-owned app, set the production client ID and secret, then validate the consent screen and CLI login in a fresh browser session.

options.title: Document an approved exception
options.body: Retain the current app only if the responsible owner explicitly confirms that the personal branding and ownership are intentional and acceptable for this authorization flow.

recommendation.title: Rotate to an official app
recommendation.body: Create or transfer an organization-owned app, set the production client ID and secret, then validate the consent screen and CLI login in a fresh browser session.

likelyOwner.reason: The live consent evidence identifies this account as the current OAuth app owner, making it the best available routing candidate for app ownership and credential access.
